response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds END) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), g AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS grand FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(m.rate - g.grand) AS avg_excess FROM m CROSS JOIN g WHERE m.rate > g.grand
